title: Qwen3-TTS demo: two friends + narrator (5 s)
notes: Run with ~/.venvs/qwentts/bin/python PIPELINE/tts/narrate.py ... --engine qwen. Each voice is designed once from its description (Qwen3-TTS VoiceDesign) and cloned for every line (Qwen3-TTS Base).

narrator.design: Male narrator, late 30s, low calm baritone, quiet late-night storytelling voice, slight rasp, unhurried.

mia.design: Teenage girl, 16, bright clear voice, teasing but a little nervous, slightly breathy, quick.
mia.ref_text: Okay, okay, I'm not scared. You're the one who's shaking. Come on, it's just an old house.

kai.design: Teenage boy, 17, tenor, playful but obviously scared, voice cracks slightly when nervous.
kai.ref_text: Me? No, no, no. I'm totally fine. I just think we should, maybe, go home now. Right now.
